summary: Phase 1 (Schema Validation Alert) and Phase 2 (Direct Vercel Private Blob Streaming) verified. All 46 backend tests pass 100%: test_schema_validator.py (4/4 - compatible, warning-on-added, blocking-on-missing-required, type-drift), test_direct_blob_streaming.py (2/2 - signed direct upload credentials + browser PUT to storage + private path verification), test_storage_adapters.py (4/4), test_csv_dialect.py (6/6), test_hardening_security.py (5/5 - includes webhook drop HMAC + batch partial results manifest), test_hardening_phase2.py (8/8), backend_test.py (17/17). Webhook drop with blocking drift halts with 422 + drift_items payload (server.py:1049-1058) and does not process silently. Batch endpoint records drift warnings in manifest and per-file blocking drift produces status=failed with descriptive error while other valid files continue (server.py:625-640). Benchmark 25/100/250MB executed successfully: 25MB 4.0s +107MB RSS, 100MB 17.0s +164MB RSS, 250MB 50.9s +472MB RSS, rows_in == rows_out integrity preserved (4,032,984 rows @ 250MB). Frontend loads correctly at preview URL with all 4 nav tabs (Limpiar archivo, Stream CSV, Procesamiento por Lotes, Webhook Automations).

minor.issue: 250MB benchmark shows +472MB RSS delta; incremental disk writes correct but pandas chunks not aggressively released. rows integrity preserved. Non-blocking, documented from iter6.

critical_code_review_comments: SchemaCompatibilityService (schema_validator.py) is a well-factored unified service reused by manual UI preview (server.py:441), batch (server.py:624) and webhook drop (server.py:1047) - single source of truth for drift classification (compatible/warning/blocking).
Webhook drop blocking drift returns HTTP 422 with structured detail {message, drift_items, missing_columns} (server.py:1051-1058) — meets spec of halting execution and not processing silently.

Batch endpoint per-file drift handling is correct: blocking drift produces failed manifest entry with continue (server.py:625-637) so other valid files proceed; warnings appended to manifest.warnings + processed_items.warnings (server.py:665,678).

Direct blob streaming endpoint (/api/storage/direct-upload-url + PUT /api/storage/direct-upload/{key}) issues UUID-based private storage_key and accepts streamed PUT bypassing server RAM buffering — matches Phase 2 contract.

Minor: type_drift branch (schema_validator.py:135) always sets 'warning' — never 'blocking' even for critical decimal->text on a required numeric column. Consider promoting to blocking when the drifted column is declared required in recipe schema. Not blocking for MVP.

Minor: response body uses inconsistent legacy status labels alongside new drift_eval (server.py:444 maps to 'compatible_with_warnings' / 'incompatible'). Ensure the UI reads drift_eval.status directly to avoid dual-source-of-truth.
